text: Given the euvolemic hyponatremia, inappropriately elevated urine osmolality and sodium, and the absence of other causes, the clinical picture is diagnostic of SIADH. DIAGNOSIS READY: Syndrome of Inappropriate Antidiuretic Hormone Secretion (SIADH)
